```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css" />
```

Average standardised concentration (mg/kg) per site for the selected element and
sediment fraction. Bulk and sieved are kept apart: pick the fraction in the sidebar.

{{< include _db-setup.qmd >}}

```{ojs}
//| output: false
L = require("https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js")

home_lat = 58
home_lng = 10
home_zoom = 4

elements = [
  { label: "Cobalt (Co)",             value: "CO" },
  { label: "Copper (Cu)",             value: "CU" },
  { label: "Iodine (I)",              value: "I" },
  { label: "Manganese (Mn)",          value: "MN" },
  { label: "Molybdenum (Mo)",         value: "MO" },
  { label: "Selenium (Se)",           value: "SE" },
  { label: "Zinc (Zn)",               value: "ZN" },
  { label: "Aluminium (Al)",          value: "AL" },
  { label: "Iron (Fe)",               value: "FE" },
  { label: "Organic carbon (CORG)",   value: "CORG" },
  { label: "Organic carbon <63 (TOC63)", value: "TOC63" }
]

fractions = [
  { label: "Bulk",   value: "bulk" },
  { label: "Sieved", value: "sieved" }
]
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
mutable clicked_point = null
```

```{ojs}
//| panel: sidebar

viewof selected_element = Inputs.select(elements, {
  label: "Element:", format: d => d.label, value: elements[6]
})

viewof selected_fraction = Inputs.select(fractions, {
  label: "Fraction:", format: d => d.label, value: fractions[0]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| panel: fill

map_data = db.query(`
  SELECT si.latitude  AS latitude,
         si.longitude AS longitude,
         AVG(m.value_std) AS avg_value
  FROM measurement m
    JOIN subsample sub ON sub.subsample_id = m.subsample_id
    JOIN event e       ON e.event_id       = sub.event_id
    JOIN site si       ON si.site_id       = e.site_id
  WHERE m.symbol = '${selected_element.value}'
    AND m.frac_class = '${selected_fraction.value}'
    AND si.latitude IS NOT NULL AND si.longitude IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY si.latitude, si.longitude
`)

value_extent = d3.extent(map_data, d => d.avg_value)
value_min = value_extent[0] ?? 0
value_max = value_extent[1] ?? 1

colorScale = d3.scaleSequential()
  .domain([value_min, value_max])
  .interpolator(d3.interpolateYlOrRd)

markerColor = v => v == null ? "#aaa" : colorScale(v)
fmtVal = v => v == null ? "N/A" : (v >= 1000 ? v.toFixed(0) : v.toFixed(2)) + " mg/kg"

{
  const container = html`<div class="map-container"><div id="map"></div></div>`
  yield container

  if (!container._map) {
    const map = L.map(container.querySelector("#map"), { zoomControl: true })
      .setView([home_lat, home_lng], home_zoom)
    L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
      attribution: "© OpenStreetMap contributors"
    }).addTo(map)

    const HomeControl = L.Control.extend({
      options: { position: "topleft" },
      onAdd(map) {
        const btn = L.DomUtil.create("a", "leaflet-home-button")
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa fa-expand" aria-hidden="true"></i>'
        btn.title = "Reset view"
        L.DomEvent.on(btn, "click", e => {
          L.DomEvent.stopPropagation(e)
          map.setView([home_lat, home_lng], home_zoom)
        })
        return btn
      }
    })
    new HomeControl().addTo(map)

    const LegendControl = L.Control.extend({
      options: { position: "bottomright" },
      onAdd() { const d = L.DomUtil.create("div", "legend"); d.id = "map-legend"; return d }
    })
    new LegendControl().addTo(map)

    container._map = map
    container._markers = L.layerGroup().addTo(map)
  }

  const { _map: map, _markers: markers } = container

  const legendEl = map.getContainer().querySelector("#map-legend")
  if (legendEl) {
    legendEl.innerHTML = `
      <div class="legend-title">${selected_element.label}</div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:#555">${selected_fraction.label}, avg mg/kg</div>
      <div class="legend-bar" style="background:linear-gradient(to right,#ffffb2,#fecc5c,#fd8d3c,#f03b20,#bd0026)"></div>
      <div class="legend-labels">
        <span>${fmtVal(value_min)}</span>
        <span>${fmtVal(value_max)}</span>
      </div>`
  }

  markers.clearLayers()
  mutable clicked_point = null

  for (const d of map_data) {
    if (d.avg_value == null) continue
    const circle = L.circleMarker([d.latitude, d.longitude], {
      radius: 6, fillColor: markerColor(d.avg_value),
      color: "#333", weight: 0.7, opacity: 1, fillOpacity: 0.85
    })
    circle.bindTooltip(
      `<b>${selected_element.label}</b><br>${fmtVal(d.avg_value)}<br>(${selected_fraction.label})`,
      { sticky: true })
    circle.on("click", () => { mutable clicked_point = { lat: d.latitude, lon: d.longitude } })
    markers.addLayer(circle)
  }
}

map_data.length === 0
  ? md`*No data for this selection.*`
  : md`**${selected_element.label}** · ${selected_fraction.label} · **${map_data.length}** sites · mg/kg`
```

```{ojs}
point_data = {
  const p = clicked_point
  if (!p) return []
  return db.query(`
    SELECT m.source AS Source,
           m.value_std AS "Value (mg/kg)",
           sub.depth_from AS "From (cm)",
           sub.depth_to AS "To (cm)",
           CAST(e.year AS TEXT) AS Year,
           mt.method AS Method
    FROM measurement m
      JOIN subsample sub ON sub.subsample_id = m.subsample_id
      JOIN event e       ON e.event_id       = sub.event_id
      JOIN site si       ON si.site_id       = e.site_id
      LEFT JOIN method mt ON mt.method_id    = m.method_id
    WHERE m.symbol = '${selected_element.value}'
      AND m.frac_class = '${selected_fraction.value}'
      AND si.latitude = ${p.lat} AND si.longitude = ${p.lon}
    ORDER BY e.year
  `)
}

clicked_point
  ? md`### ${selected_element.label} at (${clicked_point.lat.toFixed(3)}, ${clicked_point.lon.toFixed(3)})`
  : md`*Click a point on the map to see its measurements.*`

clicked_point ? Inputs.table(point_data, { layout: "auto" }) : html`<span></span>`
```
